live.title: Sunday Service
live.detail: Join from wherever you are. If data is thin, listen only.

events.title: City Crusade
events.detail: Three nights. Doors at 4. The word at 6. The media desk will stream each night in full, and the altar call will not be cut to fit a replay.

events.title: Mass prayer and the word
events.detail: Dawn watch, morning service, and evening mass prayer. All three are carried on Roadmap TV.

events.title: Healing and deliverance night
events.detail: Teaching first, then prayer. The ministry team remains after the stream ends.

events.title: Anointing water service
events.detail: Prayer over the water, then distribution. Homes that cannot attend may ask the desk to keep a bottle.

events.title: Partners' breakfast
events.detail: A report on the quarter, prayer for the crusade, and one teaching that is not put on the public stream.

updates.title: Evening prayer is the front door
updates.body: Until the crusade, the evening mass prayer leads the app. Sunday’s sermon is pinned beside it, not instead of it.

updates.title: A rule for the children’s prayers
updates.body: Healing prayer for a child is streamed wide. The media desk will not move in for a close shot. Parents may ask for the prayer to stay off the replay.

updates.title: Water service bottles
updates.body: If you cannot attend the first Saturday, send your name to the desk. Bottles are prayed over in the service and kept for collection.

partners.name: Friend of the house
partners.line: Give as you are led. Nothing in the app is locked away from you.
points: Every live prayer and every public replay
A way to send a request to the desk
News of the clinic, the baskets, and the crusade

partners.name: Pillar
partners.line: A steady monthly gift, at a figure the church will set. An illustration, not a price: the cost of one evening’s stream.
points: Your name carried in the partners’ prayer, if you want it carried
A note when the offering you helped carry has done its work

partners.name: Watchman
partners.line: Someone who takes a whole service, a clinic day, or a crusade night into their care.
points: A seat at the partners’ breakfast
A direct line to partner care
The field report before it is public

threads.title: We are holding Wednesday’s names
threads.preview: If you sent a name for healing night, it was read.

body.text: If you sent a name for Thursday’s healing night, it was read in the room and prayed for once.
You do not need to send it again unless something has changed. If it has, reply here and a person will see it.
This preview uses sample messages. Nothing here has gone to a real desk yet.

threads.title: Evening mass prayer is on air
threads.preview: Come in when you can. The door stays open.

body.text: Evening mass prayer is live from the sanctuary.
If you only have a little data, choose Listen only. You will still be in the room.

threads.title: The September note is ready
threads.preview: A short report for people who carry this house.

body.text: September’s partner note is a sample in this preview: the clinic saw its Saturday patients, the education purse paid three quiet fees, and the crusade ground is confirmed.
In the real app, this note is written by the church, not generated as filler.

threads.title: City Crusade, 3–5 October
threads.preview: Tell the desk if you need a seat kept.

body.text: The city crusade is three nights on the open ground, 3–5 October.
Streaming will run the full night. If you are coming in person and need a seat kept, write to the events desk.
